notes.title: Hello from the gardener
notes.excerpt: I make Sprout on my own, one little plant at a time. This post box is where I will tell you what is new.
body: Hi! I am Hirdyansh, and I make Sprout on my own, here in India.
This little post box is where I will write to you now and then: what is new in your garden, small tips, and sometimes a question.
Thank you for growing something with me.

notes.title: Could you help Sprout grow?
notes.excerpt: If Sprout makes your days a little brighter, a rating helps others find it.
body: If Sprout has made your days a little brighter, a rating on the App Store helps more people find it.
It takes ten seconds, and it means a lot to a tiny app made by one person. No pressure, ever.
